name: simple-drawing-pad
description: Sketch an idea by hand and paste it to Claude or any app. On Windows it needs a small helper program on your computer: built from the included source (nothing downloaded, no admin rights), it starts with Windows, works only locally (no network, collects nothing) and keeps your last 30 drawings; /simple-drawing-pad:uninstall removes it. The plugin asks once per computer before installing it. Then Ctrl+Alt+D opens the drawing window, Enter copies, Ctrl+V pastes. Simple as that.
